This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Biology and appearance==
This small bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their short stature, large appendages, [[Color|tan]] skin, black [[eye]]s, sharp teeth, and large, pointed [[ear]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==Species in the galaxy==
During [[10 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>, a member of this species could be found socializing aboard [[Dryden Vos]]'s [[Nau'ur-class yacht|''Nau'ur''-class yacht]], ''[[First Light]]'', specifically when the young [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] arrived for the first time alongside [[Chewbacca]] and [[Tobias Beckett]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Small-Big-Eared-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for this species by Ivan Manzella]]
The species made their debut in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Ron Howard]].<ref name="Solo" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella - Creature & Character Designs|archivedate=20240604150100}}</ref> The featurette "[[Scoundrels, Droids, Creatures and Cards: Welcome to Fort Ypso]]" that accompanied [[Star Wars home video releases#Solo: A Star Wars Story|the film's home release]] showed a maquette of this species present among the gambling segment at [[Fort Ypso]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]],<ref name="Fort Ypso">{{HomeVideoCite|film=Solo|featurette=Scoundrels, Droids, Creatures and Cards: Welcome to Fort Ypso}}</ref> though they were moved to the ''First Light'' for the final cut of the film.<ref name="Solo" />
